transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called this sustainment review to get confirmed updates on each material category in the holding area before I sign the disposition plan. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders awaiting disposition. I need each of you -- environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, and transportation -- to report your confirmed status on these items so I can record them in the review record and authorize release. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, sir. I'll start with the used oil. I confirmed this morning that the used oil consists of exactly 18 drums accepted by the contracted recycling service, with pickup available on 26 June. The contractor confirmation is in the environmental file, but I should note it has not yet been added to the S-4 disposition worksheet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, sir. On the vehicle batteries, I need to report a confirmed update. I counted exactly 24 cases of vehicle batteries in the holding area. The approved battery vendor requires no more than 12 cases per pallet, so the shipment must use exactly two pallets with battery-hazard labels. The count and packing instruction are documented in the motor-pool inspection folder, but I want to flag that this information has not yet been sent to logistics.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Good morning, sir. On the expired medical cold packs, I can confirm that they must be returned to Medical Supply rather than discarded locally. The return appointment is set for 25 June and is on the clinic supply calendar. However, I want to flag that this appointment has not yet been cross-referenced with the holding-area disposition plan, so it still needs to be reconciled before release is authorized.
transcript.speaker: A4

The carrier will accept the empty compressed-air cylinders only on 28 June, and they must be secured upright in a cylinder rack during loading. I should note that the carrier's acceptance note was received after the last transportation update and has not yet been added to the movement worksheet.
